title: Java signature should expose parameter-list multiline status
wanted_capability: code.signature returns a params_multiline boolean alongside params_span (Java, and Rust for parity), so parameter-list formatting checks do not need a follow-up code.read of params_span.
evidence: crates/bro-harness/src/bindings/code_facts.rs: signature_payload and the RustSignature/JavaSignature type declarations
notes: The newly added Java `params_span` was useful and sufficient; this is a small convenience iteration surfaced by the resumed probe.
resolution_note: Transferred to https://github.com/daystrom-institute/blackbox/issues/22, now the canonical implementation work item. Signature facts still expose params_span without a params_multiline fact for Java or Rust. Verified against accepted beta 93c2d391a8d6b8d2d760b88b1acdadbafc7a3ea4. Gap triage is complete; the GitHub issue remains open and this transfer does not claim the capability is implemented.
